def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df.loc[df['sex'].isin(['', 'nan', 'None']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
